import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
import numpy as np

# First, let's check what data is available for October 5, 2025
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00' AND datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total hourly records on Oct 5, 2025: {result['cnt'].values[0]}")

# Get station info and their types
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, station_type
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
""")
stations = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("\nStation types:")
print(stations.to_string())

# Now compute daily average O3/NO2 ratio for each station, only where both are available
query = text("""
SELECT 
    h.station_id,
    aqs.name_en,
    aqs.station_type,
    AVG(h.o3 / NULLIF(h.no2, 0)) as ox_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as valid_hours,
    AVG(h.o3) as avg_o3,
    AVG(h.no2) as avg_no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON h.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE h.datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00' 
  AND h.datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
  AND h.o3 IS NOT NULL 
  AND h.no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND h.no2 > 0
GROUP BY h.station_id, aqs.name_en, aqs.station_type
ORDER BY ox_ratio DESC
""")
ratios = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("\nPhotochemical oxidant partitioning ratios (O3/NO2) by station:")
print(ratios.to_string())

# Compute mean ratios for roadside vs general stations
roadside = ratios[ratios['station_type'] == 'ROADSIDE']
general = ratios[ratios['station_type'] == 'GENERAL']

roadside_mean = round(roadside['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)
general_mean = round(general['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

print(f"Roadside stations mean O3/NO2 ratio: {roadside_mean}")
print(f"General stations mean O3/NO2 ratio: {general_mean}")

# Station with highest ratio
highest = ratios.iloc[0]
highest_station = highest['name_en']
highest_ratio = round(highest['ox_ratio'], 3)
print(f"\nHighest ratio station: {highest_station} ({highest_ratio})")

# Now compute time-of-day breakdown for the highest-ratio station (Tap Mun, station_id=8)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM datetime) as hour,
    o3 / NULLIF(no2, 0) as ox_ratio
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 8
  AND datetime >= '2025-10-05 00:00:00' 
  AND datetime < '2025-10-06 00:00:00'
  AND o3 IS NOT NULL 
  AND no2 IS NOT NULL
  AND no2 > 0
ORDER BY hour
""")
tap_mun = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Morning: 06:00-09:00 (hours 6,7,8)
morning = tap_mun[(tap_mun['hour'] >= 6) & (tap_mun['hour'] < 9)]
morning_ox_val = round(morning['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

# Midday: 11:00-14:00 (hours 11,12,13)
midday = tap_mun[(tap_mun['hour'] >= 11) & (tap_mun['hour'] < 14)]
midday_ox_val = round(midday['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

# Evening: 17:00-20:00 (hours 17,18,19)
evening = tap_mun[(tap_mun['hour'] >= 17) & (tap_mun['hour'] < 20)]
evening_ox_val = round(evening['ox_ratio'].mean(), 3)

print(f"\nTap Mun time-of-day ratios:")
print(f"  Morning (06:00-09:00): {morning_ox_val} (n={len(morning)})")
print(f"  Midday (11:00-14:00): {midday_ox_val} (n={len(midday)})")
print(f"  Evening (17:00-20:00): {evening_ox_val} (n={len(evening)})")

# Store results
roadside_ox_ratio = roadside_mean
general_ox_ratio = general_mean
highest_ox_station = highest_station
highest_ox_ratio = highest_ratio
morning_ox = morning_ox_val
midday_ox = midday_ox_val
evening_ox = evening_ox_val

print("\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
print(f"roadside_ox_ratio = {roadside_ox_ratio}")
print(f"general_ox_ratio = {general_ox_ratio}")
print(f"highest_ox_station = '{highest_ox_station}'")
print(f"highest_ox_ratio = {highest_ox_ratio}")
print(f"morning_ox = {morning_ox}")
print(f"midday_ox = {midday_ox}")
print(f"evening_ox = {evening_ox}")
